# Sample trial data

## Point estimate

```{r}
set.seed(03111963)
trialdf=trial_sampler(pop,id,trt,20,50) %>% 
  group_by(id) %>% 
  mutate(id=cur_group_id())
```

## Boostrapping

```{r}
boot_sample=bootstrap_sampler(trialdf,id,trt,20,50)
```

# Matching

Define methods

```{r}
grid=c("exact_greedy","exact_optimal",
                   "psm_p_greedy_noc","psm_p_greedy_caliper_01","psm_p_greedy_caliper_005",
                   "psm_m_greedy_noc","psm_m_greedy_caliper_01","psm_m_greedy_caliper_005",
                   "psm_p_optimal","psm_m_optimal")
```

## Point estimate

Run matching procedure

```{r,eval=FALSE}
matched=matching_call(data=trialdf,id,ratio=1,methods=grid[1])
```

Run model

```{r}
point=run_all_matching(data=trialdf,ratio=2,methods=grid)
```

## Bootstrapping

Loop

```{r}
B=3;points=data.frame()
for (b in 1:B){
  # bootstrap from dataset
  boot_sample=bootstrap_sampler(trialdf,id,trt,20,50)
  # run procedures
  point=run_all_matching(data=boot_sample,id=id,ratio=2,methods=grid)
  # attach number of iteration
  point$b=b
  # bind
  points=bind_rows(points,point)
}
```

# Not matching

## Point estimate

Methods

```{r}
methods=c("raw",
          "iptw, unstabilised","iptw, stabilised, truncated 0.1","iptw, stabilised, truncated 0.01",
          "gcomp")
```

Prepare data

```{r}
preprocess=regression_call(data=trialdf,id=id,methods=methods[2])
```

Run one procedure

```{r}
example=analyse_call(data=preprocess,
                     methods=methods[2])
```

Run all together

```{r}
examples = run_all_regression(data = trialdf,
                              id=id,
                              methods = methods,
                              landmark = 2)
```

## Bootstrapping

Loop

```{r}
B=3;points=data.frame()
for (b in 1:B){
  # bootstrap from dataset
  boot_sample=bootstrap_sampler(trialdf,id,trt,20,50)
  # run procedures
  point=run_all_regression(data = boot_sample,
                              id=id,
                              methods = methods,
                              landmark = 2)
  # attach number of iteration
  point$b=b
  # bind
  points=bind_rows(points,point)
}
```
